svg.title: Botbench — Put your coding agents to work. Together.
svg.desc: The two-tone Shared Seam Botbench logo, followed by the product promise and description.
svg.metadata:
Source of the lockup below: assets/svg/botbench-lockup-two-tone-light.svg Git blob: e02d1db7191f456f522f1284887764018df3197e Its paths, fills, wordmark text and type attributes are copied unchanged. Brand rule: DESIGN.md and PR #230 (387555d9ea1203db2d94b710721a3af48dbe434e). This is marketing artwork. No recorded product screenshot is edited.
Rebuild from the repository root with Inkscape 1.4 and Liberation Sans installed: inkscape docs/media/social-preview.svg --export-area-page --export-type=png --export-width=1280 --export-height=640 --export-png-color-mode=RGB_8 --export-filename=docs/media/social-preview.png
No application package or runtime dependency is required. Inkscape resolves the canonical lockup's platform-font stack; font substitution may change wordmark metrics on another OS.

g.text: Put your coding agents to work. Together.
One workbench for your agents. One coordination layer for your team.
Local-first · Bring your agents · Open source
